dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor.

dialogue.content: こんにちは
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: 年齢、性別、本日のご相談内容をお知らせいただけますか？
dialogue.English: Could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 23歳、女性、仕事が辛いです
dialogue.English: I'm 23, female, and I'm having a hard time at work.

dialogue.content: 教えてくださり、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: お仕事の悩みは辛いですよね
dialogue.English: Work-related worries can be really difficult, can't they?

dialogue.content: どんな時に辛いと感じられますか？
dialogue.English: When do you feel it's particularly tough?

dialogue.content: 新卒の1年目なんですが、仕事が覚えられなくて。
dialogue.English: I'm a first-year new graduate, and I can't seem to learn the job.

dialogue.content: 分からないのが辛いです
dialogue.English: Not understanding things is what's painful.

dialogue.content: なるほど。わからないことがあるのは辛いですよね
dialogue.English: I see. It must be tough not knowing things.

dialogue.content: 辛いし、情けないですもうどうしたらいいのか…
dialogue.English: It's painful and I feel pathetic—I don't know what to do anymore...

dialogue.content: 指導してくださる先輩にはお話しされたことありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you spoken with the senior colleague who is mentoring you?

dialogue.content: 3年目の先輩が指導担当です。定期的に面談あるし、仕事の指導もあります。
dialogue.English: A third-year senior colleague is in charge of my training. We have regular meetings, and they also guide me in my work.

dialogue.content: なるほど。定期的な相談できる場はあるのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So there is a regular opportunity for you to consult with them.

dialogue.content: でも、分からなくて、面談室にいく時はドナドナのような気持ちで、恥ずかしいです
dialogue.English: But I don't understand things, so when I go to the meeting room, I feel like a lamb to the slaughter, and it's embarrassing.

dialogue.content: ドナドナ…連行されている気持ちなのですね…
dialogue.English: Like a lamb to the slaughter... so you feel like you're being hauled off against your will...

dialogue.content: 同期の方はいらっしゃったりしますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have any colleagues who started at the same time as you?

dialogue.content: 同じ部署にはいません。他部署にはいて、仲はいいです
dialogue.English: Not in the same department. There are some in other departments, and we get along well.

dialogue.content: 仲の良い同期の方がいらっしゃるのはいいことですね！
dialogue.English: It's wonderful that you have colleagues you get along with!

dialogue.content: よくみんなで愚痴ってます
dialogue.English: We often vent together.

dialogue.content: 愚痴をこぼせる仲間がいるのはいいですね！
dialogue.English: It's nice to have friends you can vent to!

dialogue.content: 休職する子もいて、自分も休みたい…
dialogue.English: Some of them are taking a leave of absence, and I want to take a break too...

dialogue.content: 励まし合えるのはいいけど、愚痴では解決しないし
dialogue.English: It's good that we can encourage each other, but venting doesn't solve anything.

dialogue.content: なるほど…有給や夏休みはとれる環境ですか？
dialogue.English: I see... Is it easy to take paid leave or summer vacation there?

dialogue.content: 有給や休みは取りやすい会社です。
dialogue.English: It's a company where it's easy to take paid leave and time off.

dialogue.content: お休み取りやすいのはいいことですね
dialogue.English: It's great that time off is easy to take.

dialogue.content: 先ほど恥ずかしいとおっしゃられていましたが、同じチームの方に見られるのが恥ずかしいのですか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned feeling embarrassed earlier; is it embarrassing to be seen by your team members?

dialogue.content: 福利厚生がいいので、辞めたくないです。
dialogue.English: The benefits are good, so I don't want to quit.

dialogue.content: そうです。他の人に、情けない所を見られるのが恥ずかしいです。
dialogue.English: That's right. I'm embarrassed that other people see my pathetic side.

dialogue.content: 福利厚生は大事な会社選びの要素ですよね
dialogue.English: Benefits are an important factor in choosing a company, aren't they?

dialogue.content: 今まで、学生時代も入社研修も評価されてきたのに、こんなのは初めてで、情けない。恥ずかしいです
dialogue.English: Until now, I was well regarded in school and during onboarding, so this is the first time I've experienced anything like this. I feel pathetic and embarrassed.

dialogue.content: 差し支えなければ、どのようにおよびすればよいか、教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: If you don't mind, how would you like me to address you?

dialogue.content: プリンでお願いします
dialogue.English: Please call me Purin.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。プリンさんですね
dialogue.English: Thank you. Purin, right?

dialogue.content: きっと、プリンさんは頑張り屋さんなので、ご自身でいろいろとこなされることが多かったのかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: I imagine you're very hardworking, Purin, so you may have often handled many things on your own.

dialogue.content: 今までたくさん頑張ってこられたのですね
dialogue.English: You've worked so hard up until now.

dialogue.content: 頑張ってきたとは思います。だから、今の自分が許せない、恥ずかしいです
dialogue.English: I believe I have worked hard. That's why I can't forgive myself now; I'm so embarrassed.

dialogue.content: なるほど...こなせない理想の自分と今の自分とのギャップが苦しいのかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: I see... Perhaps the gap between your ideal self who can handle everything and your current self is causing you pain.

dialogue.content: お休みを取りやすいということですので、折角でしたら気分転換にどこかお出かけするのはいかかでしょうか
dialogue.English: Since you mentioned it's easy to take time off, how about going somewhere for a change of pace?

dialogue.content: すみません。もう少しプリンさんのことを聞かせてください
dialogue.English: My apologies. Could you tell me a bit more about yourself, Purin?

dialogue.content: ギャップ、そうかもしれません。今の自分は今までの自分と比べるとゴミみたい。人生の汚点です
dialogue.English: The gap, yes, that might be it. Compared to my past self, my current self feels like trash. It's a stain on my life.

dialogue.content: なるほど。そう思われているのですね
dialogue.English: I see. That's how you feel.

dialogue.content: 私のことですか。
dialogue.English: About me?

dialogue.content: はい、プリンさんがどのようなご自身だったらよいと思われるのか教えていただけたら…
dialogue.English: Yes, if you could tell me what kind of self you think would be ideal for you, Purin...

dialogue.content: 私は、確かに頑張ってきました。会社も一流企業に入って、どんどん昇進したいと思ってました。でも、仕事を任せられるようになって、マニュアルが多くて理解が追いつかないんです
dialogue.English: I have certainly worked hard. I joined a top-tier company and wanted to get promoted quickly. But now that I'm being entrusted with work, there are so many manuals that I can't keep up.

dialogue.content: なるほど。マニュアルの多さにご苦労されている状況なのですね
dialogue.English: I see. You're struggling with the sheer number of manuals.

dialogue.content: お仕事を任される機会があるとのことですが、そのことについてはどのようにお考えですか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned you're being entrusted with work—how do you feel about that?

dialogue.content: そうです。先輩はマニュアルを覚えろとか、休日に1時間だけでも仕事の勉強しろと言うけど、休日に仕事したくないです。
dialogue.English: Yes. My senior says things like 'Memorize the manuals' or 'Study work for just an hour on your days off,' but I don't want to work on my days off.

dialogue.content: マニュアルのどこに書いてあるか教えてほしいです。
dialogue.English: I just want them to tell me where to find it in the manual.

dialogue.content: お休みの日はしっかりお休みしたくなりますもんね。
dialogue.English: Of course, you want to rest properly on your days off.

dialogue.content: 休みたいです。ジムに行ったり、遊びにも行きたいし。
dialogue.English: I want to rest. I want to go to the gym and go out and have fun.

dialogue.content: ジムや遊びに行くのはいい気分転換になりますもんね
dialogue.English: Going to the gym or going out can be a great way to refresh your mind, can't it?

dialogue.content: 直接指導してくださる先輩社員さん以外にも、質問したらお答えいただける同僚の方はいらっしゃいますか
dialogue.English: Besides the senior colleague who directly mentors you, are there other colleagues who can answer your questions?

dialogue.content: 隣の席の先輩に質問してます。また？　って顔されるのはしんどいです。
dialogue.English: I ask the senior colleague sitting next to me. But it's tough when they give me a look that says, "Again?"

dialogue.content: 定期的に部長の面談もあって、それも苦痛。
dialogue.English: There are also regular meetings with the department head, and those are painful too.

dialogue.content: お隣の席の先輩にご質問なさっているのですね
dialogue.English: So you've been asking questions to the colleague next to you.

dialogue.content: 教えてはもらえます
dialogue.English: They do explain things.

dialogue.content: 部長面談もあるのですね。その際はどのようなお話をされていますか
dialogue.English: So you have meetings with the department head as well. What sort of things do you talk about then?

dialogue.content: 仕事の中で困った事を話します。マニュアルで困ってる事も伝えています。何も変わらないけど
dialogue.English: I talk about the difficulties I have in my work. I also tell them I'm struggling with the manuals—but nothing changes.

dialogue.content: 体調が辛いことも伝えてます
dialogue.English: I also tell them that I'm not feeling well physically.

dialogue.content: なるほど。マニュアルで困られていることもお話しされているのですね。しっかり伝えられているプリンさんの勇気が素晴らしいなと思いました
dialogue.English: I see. So you are telling them about the trouble you're having with the manuals. I think it's wonderful that you have the courage to communicate that so clearly, Purin.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。伝えようとはしています。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'm trying to communicate.

dialogue.content: 体調お辛いのですね…今は大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: It must be hard not feeling well... Are you alright at the moment?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Thank you very much!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！お仕事大変みたいですが、応援してます！
dialogue.English: Thank you very much! It sounds like work is tough, but I'm rooting for you!
